name: cmdb_export
reveals: Declared CIs, attributes, relationships, locations, departments, groups, changes
raw: CSV list exports; references as sys_ids (cmdb_rel_ci parent/child/type)

name: discovery_scanner
reveals: Devices that exist (serial, hostname, IP, OS) and services listening on host ports
raw: IRE payload JSON {items[className, values], relations} per scan batch + scan schedule

name: apm_otel
reveals: Application-to-application and application-to-database calls, errors, latency
raw: Prometheus text exposition scrapes (traces_service_graph_*) + OTLP/JSON span sample

name: netflow
tool: IPFIX / NetFlow v9 collector (nfdump aggregated CSV)
reveals: Network conversations, including un-instrumented devices (modalities, analysers, pumps)
raw: nfdump -o csv aggregated records (ts, te, sa, da, sp, dp, pr, ipkt, ibyt)

name: interface_engine
tool: HL7 interface engine (Mirth Connect / NextGen Connect)
reveals: Each HL7/DICOM route's real destinations, including database writers, and message volumes
raw: Mirth channel export XML + daily channel/connector statistics CSV

name: backup_software
tool: Backup & recovery software (Veeam job session report)
reveals: Which objects are really backed up, copied off-site or to the immutable vault, and results
raw: Job session CSV (job, type, object, start, end, result, repository, bytes)

name: storage_telemetry
tool: Array management REST API (Pure Storage FlashArray)
reveals: Array replication pairs: mode, lag, last transfer, state
raw: Protection group / replica link JSON samples (hourly)

name: identity_sso
reveals: Which users sign in to which applications, from which workstation

name: db_audit
reveals: Who reads, writes and administers production databases

name: itsm_history
reveals: Which team really resolves incidents and implements changes per CI
